items.name: Mac Raynolds
items.quote: Valentyn was a total pleasure to work with - he's one of the rare audio designers who is dangerous in both SFX and music. He came in later to our project and jumped in with both feet. He was collaborative, quick, and super creative. Any team would be lucky to have him

items.name: Tim Blueris
items.quote:
Working with Valentyn Chumachenko was an absolute pleasure. As a Sound Designer and Music Composer on our project, he brought a unique emotional layer to the experience that elevated everything from gameplay moments to cinematic sequences.

Valentyn is incredibly versatile: he can design impactful SFX that hit just right in combat, then shift gears to compose a dynamic combat track. He has a strong sense of pacing and knows exactly how audio supports narrative, tension, and player immersion.

He’s collaborative, open to feedback, fast when needed, and detail-oriented when it counts. If you need someone to bring your game world to life through sound, Valentyn is that person

items.name: Matthew Berger
items.quote:
I had the pleasure of working directly with Valentyn on Last Flag which was a 5v5 hero shooter. Last Flag was a tricky project from an audio perspective with big over the top characters, quirky abilities and gameplay elements that needed a lot of feedback provided to players. 

All of this and more often made finding the correct sound tricky but Valentyn was always up to the task. Throughout the whole process he maintains a positive attitude, a quiet determination to find the correct sound. Always willing to try something different, something new, accepting any odd reference or piece of feedback ("make it sound more golden") and translating that into audio. 

He also brought new and interesting ideas to the audio landscape that really improved the joy which sound brought to players. Valentyn proved himself an integral part of the team and for large parts of the process was the only audio designer meaning he had a lot of terrain to cover but he did so admirably.

items.name: Anjan Shah
items.quote:
Valentyn is very responsive, quick and musically very proficient ready to offer ideas to enhance your project. The project I used him for needed authentic sounding digital strings. 

His proficiency using Berlin Strings coupled with his musical experience and intuition combined to create exactly what was required for this project. His ability to edit quickly and provide a final mix makes him a 'go-to' for short-fuse projects.

 Finally, his communication style is direct and very open to collaboration. I will definitely use him for future projects.

items.name: Sergey Timoshin
items.quote:
I truly enjoyed working with Valentyn on Moonray.

Valentyn is the kind of specialist who never limits himself to simply completing assigned tasks. He immerses himself deeply in the product, its atmosphere, and its goals, constantly looking for opportunities to improve the result and raise the overall quality bar.

He has strong technical and systems expertise, can design complex audio systems, and is highly proficient with Wwise. At the same time, Valentyn does not focus solely on his own area of responsibility. He closely follows the overall state of the product, provides valuable feedback beyond audio, and actively contributes to solving broader team and development challenges.

I particularly value his independence, initiative, and high standards for his own work. Valentyn proactively establishes the communication needed to move things forward, responds constructively to feedback, and continues to advocate for product quality even in difficult situations.

His broad industry awareness, excellent understanding of current trends, and constant interest in new technologies and optimization made him a key member of the development team.

I can confidently recommend Valentyn as a highly skilled, motivated, and genuinely committed professional. Valentyn is truly one of the best, and I would be delighted to work with him again.

items.name: Dave Lowmiller
items.quote:
I had the pleasure of working with Valentyn at Night Street Games, where he made significant contributions to the audio experience of *Last Flag*. He consistently delivered high-quality sound design and demonstrated a strong understanding of both the creative and technical aspects of game audio.

Valentyn is highly skilled with Wwise and Unreal Engine, allowing him to implement and iterate on audio efficiently while working closely with the rest of the team. He is proactive, receptive to feedback, and always focused on finding the best solution for the player experience.

Beyond his technical expertise, Valentyn is a reliable and collaborative teammate who takes ownership of his work and maintains a high standard of quality. I would confidently recommend him to any studio looking for a talented sound designer with strong implementation skills and a professional approach.

items.name: Rodrigo Etcheto
items.quote:
Valentyn played a key role in shaping the audio experience of *Moonray*. As the project's sole Sound Designer, he took ownership of the game's audio direction, delivering high-quality sound design, music, and implementation that supported both the gameplay and the overall artistic vision.

He combines creativity with strong technical expertise, working confidently with Wwise and Unreal Engine to build scalable audio systems and deliver polished results. Throughout development, Valentyn consistently demonstrated initiative, professionalism, and a commitment to quality.

I would confidently recommend Valentyn to any studio looking for a versatile audio professional who can take ownership of a project's audio and deliver exceptional results.

items.name: Vladimir Marin
items.quote:
I had the pleasure of working with Valentyn on the music production for a large-scale stadium opening ceremony. From the very beginning, he demonstrated a strong understanding of the creative vision and translated it into music that supported the atmosphere, emotion, and scale of the event.

Valentyn is a talented composer who combines creativity with professionalism. He was responsive to feedback, delivered high-quality work on schedule, and consistently found musical solutions that elevated the production.

I would confidently recommend Valentyn to anyone looking for a composer who can create impactful music for live events, film, games, or other large-scale productions.

items.name: Oles Iusypchuk
items.quote:
Oles has a distinctive creative vision that helped shape the series into something that appealed to a broad audience. His storytelling combined unexpected twists, memorable humor, and meaningful themes, resulting in a project with both entertainment value and lasting character.

Beyond his creative talent, Oles is a dedicated and collaborative professional who genuinely believes in the projects he works on. His passion, artistic vision, and commitment were instrumental to the success of the series.

items.name: Kate Wilga
items.quote:
I had the pleasure of working with Valentyn on *Last Flag*, where he was responsible for sound design and audio implementation. He consistently delivered high-quality work across a wide range of gameplay features, with a strong understanding of both the creative and technical aspects of game audio.

Valentyn is highly proficient with Wwise and Unreal Engine, making collaboration between audio and engineering smooth and efficient. He communicates clearly, is proactive in solving problems, and always strives to find solutions that improve both the player experience and the development workflow.

I would confidently recommend Valentyn to any game development team looking for a skilled sound designer with solid technical expertise and a collaborative approach.

items.name: Lizzy van Drom
items.quote:
We worked with Valentyn on multiple commercial video projects, where he was responsible for both music composition and sound design. He consistently delivered high-quality work that elevated the overall production and matched the creative direction of each campaign.

Valentyn has a great sense of timing, storytelling, and emotion, creating audio that supports the visuals without overpowering them. He is reliable, easy to collaborate with, and always receptive to feedback, delivering polished results on schedule.

I would confidently recommend Valentyn to any creative agency or production team looking for a talented composer and sound designer who combines creativity with professionalism.

items.name: Frederic Bibard
items.quote:
I've had the pleasure of working with Valentyn on several audiobook production projects, and the quality of his work was consistently outstanding. He handled the entire post-production process—from dialogue editing and cleanup to mastering—with great attention to detail and professionalism.

Communication was always smooth, deadlines were met without compromise, and every delivery required little to no revision. His ability to enhance recordings while preserving a natural, engaging sound made a noticeable difference in the final product.

I would happily work with Valentyn again and highly recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and highly skilled audio professional.

items.name: Vladimir Belik
items.quote:
I've worked with Valentyn on several recording sessions and had the opportunity to collaborate with him on music arrangements as well. From recording to the final production, he consistently delivered professional results and paid close attention to every detail.

Valentyn has a great musical ear and understands how to bring out the best in a performance. His arrangements always complemented the song naturally, and his production work helped turn ideas into polished, release-ready tracks. Recording sessions were efficient, comfortable, and creatively inspiring.

I would confidently recommend Valentyn to any artist looking for a skilled producer, arranger, and audio engineer who combines musical talent with professionalism and a genuine commitment to quality.

items.name: Evgen Ivanisov
items.quote:
I worked with Valentyn for about a year at the same television channel, where we collaborated closely on live broadcasts and studio productions. During that time, he consistently demonstrated professionalism, technical competence, and a calm approach in fast-paced production environments.

Valentyn has a solid understanding of broadcast audio workflows, adapts quickly to changing production requirements, and pays close attention to detail. He is reliable, communicates well with the team, and can always be trusted to deliver high-quality work under pressure.

I would confidently recommend Valentyn to any broadcast or production team looking for a skilled, dependable, and dedicated audio professional.
